title: Practice 10: Фёдор Достоевский · Ёлка и свадьба

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.why: «The verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups»: reflexive (я моюсь), intransitive (урок продолжается), reciprocal (мы встречаемся), and verbs which never occur without "-ся". — DLI, Lesson 67. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».

exercises.q: Теперь он стоял в раздумье и как будто что-то ___ (рассчитывать) по пальцам.
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Фёдор Достоевский, «Ёлка и свадьба».
